what_the_document_says: All models get the same full annual validation with a single methodology, 'regardless of model type and purpose'. There is no risk-based model ranking (tiering).
requirement: Validation must be risk-based: models must be ranked or grouped by materiality and model-use risk, and validation intensity must match the risk level.
verbatim_quote_ka: 41. შიდა ვალიდაციის პროცესი უნდა წარიმართოს რისკზე დაფუძნებული მიდგომის გამოყენებით.
expected_fix: Add a tiering methodology (materiality + use risk) and tier-dependent validation scope and frequency. Add a tier field to the inventory.

what_the_document_says: Verification relies on the developer's documentation and tests plus sampled code review. Validators do not re-run the model with the first line's data and code.
requirement: From 2022 the second line must run the model on the first line's data and code and compare the results, and must check data accuracy, code correctness and change control.
verbatim_quote_ka: ბ.ა) პროცესების ვერიფიკაციის ეტაპზე მოწმდება მოდელის კომპონენტების ფუნქციონირების გამართულობა:
expected_fix: Require independent replication (re-run) by validators, with validator access to the development environment.

what_the_document_says: Expert overrides are allowed whenever the owner 'considers' the score wrong. They are logged with a reason only, with no quantitative justification.
requirement: Replacing results or parameters by expert judgement must be justified by quantitative analysis, including back-testing, and kept under ongoing monitoring.
verbatim_quote_ka: ბ.ბ1) თუ მოდელის ვალიდაციის შედეგები არადამაკმაყოფილებელია და ახალი მონაცემებისა და…
expected_fix: Add override governance: quantitative justification, back-testing of overrides, and monitoring thresholds.

what_the_document_says: A model is escalated for restriction only when data accuracy is in doubt. The broader case where data quality standards cannot be confirmed is not covered, and restriction is optional ('will consider').
requirement: The 2022 wording makes failure to confirm that the data quality standards and policies are met grounds for restricting or suspending the model, not only doubts about accuracy.
verbatim_quote_ka: 5. თუ მოდელის გამომყენებელი სუბიექტი ვერ რწმუნდება, რომ მონაცემთა ხარისხთან…
expected_fix: Rewrite 4.3.3 so that non-confirmed data quality, measured against the 4.3.1 standard, triggers restriction or suspension.

what_the_document_says: Complex methods (gradient boosting, neural networks) are allowed purely for accuracy. Performance is assessed by Gini, KS and AUC only. There is no transparency or explainability requirement.
requirement: Models must be explainable. Black-box models need global methods (PDP, variable importance, surrogate models) and local methods (ICE, Shapley values, LIME). The need grows with customer impact and automation.
verbatim_quote_ka: 101. მოდელი უნდა იყოს გამჭვირვალე და უნდა იძლეოდეს ახსნისა და ინტერპრეტაციის შესაძლებლობას.
expected_fix: Add an explainability section with required global and local methods for complex models and a transparency check during testing.

what_the_document_says: There is no definition of 'deviation' (bias) and no requirement to avoid it. Ethics is limited to banning protected attributes as direct variables.
requirement: The 2022 amendment adds a definition of deviation and a new Article 9¹: avoiding deviation and ensuring transparency are minimum principles, with mitigation measures a–g.
verbatim_quote_ka: ზ) გადახრა – მონაცემებში ან/და ალგორითმში არსებული კანონზომიერება, რომლის გამოც სისტემატურად…
expected_fix: Add the deviation definition and an ethics chapter covering Art. 9¹ (principles, deviation types, mitigation measures, customer explanation and awareness).

what_the_document_says: It cites the 2018 ethics code (Order №154/04 of 09.07.2018).
requirement: From 2022 commercial banks must follow the ethics code approved by NBG Order №13/04 of 02.02.2021. The 154/04 reference is outdated.
verbatim_quote_ka: 3. მოდელის მართვის პროცესში მოდელის გამომყენებელმა სუბიექტმა უნდა შეიმუშაოს ეთიკის პრინციპები…
expected_fix: Replace the reference with Order №13/04 (02.02.2021).

what_the_document_says: Third-party controls cover only documentation at purchase. There is no periodic receipt of the vendor's test results, no in-house monitoring capability if the vendor does not monitor, no own-data testing when vendor documents are missing, and no risk-based review.
requirement: Since 2022: test on own data if vendor documents are unavailable; regularly obtain the vendor's test results and check them against risk appetite; have resources to monitor if the vendor doesn't; review purchased models on a risk basis.
verbatim_quote_ka: 41. მოდელის გამომყენებელი სუბიექტი მესამე მხარისგან რეგულარულად უნდა იღებდეს…
expected_fix: Extend 7.1 with the 9.4–4³ obligations and the matching contractual clauses (SLA).

what_the_document_says: The outsourcing clause refers to the 47/04 principles and three-lines independence, but has no condition that outsourcing must not hinder supervision.
requirement: The 2023 amendment adds that outsourcing of model building, validation or audit must not hinder the supervisory process.
verbatim_quote_ka: რათა ხელი არ შეეშალოს ზედამხედველობის პროცესს
expected_fix: Add the 'must not hinder supervision' condition, for example NBG access rights in outsourcing contracts.

what_the_document_says: Launch is approved by the Model Committee, which is chaired by the CRO (second line) and includes the head of RAMD (developer and validator). The approver is not independent of the lines of defence.
requirement: Approval to launch must come from a person or body independent of the lines of defence, with technical competence.
verbatim_quote_ka: თანხმობა უნდა გასცეს დაცვის ხაზებისაგან დამოუკიდებელმა პირმა/ორგანომ
expected_fix: Assign approval to a body or person independent of the lines of defence, such as a management-level committee without the CRO and RAMD voting, or the CEO with advice.

what_the_document_says: The validation group sits inside RAMD with the development groups, and the head of RAMD approves validation reports. Independence relies only on 'not validating your own model'.
requirement: Validation must be independent of development and use. The three lines must be independent.
verbatim_quote_ka: შიდა ვალიდაცია მოდელის აგებისა და გამოყენებისგან დამოუკიდებლად უნდა განხორციელდეს.
expected_fix: Separate the validation function from model development, with a separate reporting line, for example to the CRO directly or a separate unit.

what_the_document_says: Three lines described as 'business function / control function / independent assurance', with the second line's power to restrict or ban use.
requirement: Compliant control in different wording. It should NOT be flagged.

what_the_document_says: A contingency plan is required for every third-party model.
requirement: Compliant. It should NOT be flagged. (The inventory D2 violates this policy rule; see D2-02.)

what_the_document_says: Proxy variables are documented, and scenario testing (baseline, optimistic, pessimistic) is required.
requirement: Compliant. It should NOT be flagged.

what_the_document_says: Supervisory models: NBG consent, monthly reporting, annual update, prior notice of changes.
requirement: Compliant at policy level. It should NOT be flagged. (D11 contradicts it; see D11-02 and D11-03.)
verbatim_quote_ka: ყოველთვიურად წარუდგინოს საქართველოს ეროვნულ ბანკს ანგარიშგება

what_the_document_says: There is no risk tier or materiality attribute. Every model's next validation is set mechanically at 12 months.
requirement: Validation must be risk-based, which needs a model ranking or grouping by risk level.

expected_fix: Add tier, materiality and use-risk columns; derive validation frequency from the tier.

what_the_document_says: The vendor fraud model M-005 has 'no contingency plan'.
requirement: A plan is required in case a third-party model becomes unavailable. It also breaks the bank's own policy, 7.3.1.
verbatim_quote_ka: გეგმა იმ შემთხვევისთვის, თუ მესამე მხარის მოდელი აღარ იქნება ხელმისაწვდომი
expected_fix: Define and document a contingency plan for M-005.

regulation_article: Art. 6 para 3; Art. 3 para 3; Art. 8 para 1
what_the_document_says: The vendor collections model M-007 is in production with no internal validation; the vendor's report was accepted instead.
requirement: Internal validation covers third-party models too, and launch requires a positive assessment by all lines.
verbatim_quote_ka: შესყიდული მოდელის შიდა და მესამე მხარის მიერ შესასრულებელი ვალიდაციისათვის აუცილებელი მოთხოვნები
expected_fix: Perform the internal validation of M-007; restrict use until it is complete.

what_the_document_says: The supervisory income model M-002 has been in production since 01.06.2021. NBG consent was only applied for on 10.08.2021 and is still pending, and there is no internal validation.
requirement: The income assessment model is a supervisory model whose use requires NBG's prior consent, and an internal validation must be part of the application.
verbatim_quote_ka: 2020 წლის 13 მარტის №44/04 ბრძანებით დამტკიცებული დებულებით
expected_fix: Stop or limit use until consent is granted; complete the internal validation.

what_the_document_says: The 'validation' of M-005 was only a review of the vendor's documentation.
requirement: Validation must cover inputs, calculations and outputs, for in-house and third-party models alike. A documentation review alone is partial.
expected_fix: Perform a full validation of M-005, or record it explicitly as partial with a remediation plan.

what_the_document_says: Validators did not re-run the model (no access to the development environment) and relied on the developer's own LOS-versus-model comparison.
requirement: The second line must run the model with the first line's data and code and compare the results.
verbatim_quote_ka: ბ.ა) პროცესების ვერიფიკაციის ეტაპზე მოწმდება მოდელის კომპონენტების ფუნქციონირების გამართულობა:
expected_fix: Give validators access to the environment; replicate the scores independently.

what_the_document_says: The only interpretability evidence is LightGBM gain importance, and further analysis is called 'not needed'. Yet 78% of decisions are automated and customer-facing.
requirement: Black-box models require global methods (PDP, variable importance, surrogate tree) and local methods (ICE, SHAP, LIME). The need increases with customer impact and automation.
verbatim_quote_ka: 102. იმ ტიპის მოდელების შემთხვევაში, სადაც რთულია სრული წარმოდგენის შექმნა…
expected_fix: Add PDP/ICE, SHAP and surrogate-model analysis; assess whether reason codes can be produced for customers.

what_the_document_says: Municipality (as an income proxy) and age are among the top-5 drivers. There is no bias or deviation testing and no check that the proxy has a causal link to the outcome.
requirement: Proxy variables must not be used unless they have a causal link to the outcome. Deviation must be identified and mitigated.
verbatim_quote_ka: ჩამნაცვლებელი ცვლადი არ უნდა გამოიყენებოდეს…
expected_fix: Run fairness and deviation analysis (by age, region); justify causality or remove the proxy.

what_the_document_says: The sample covers 2015–2020, including the 2020 deferral period, with no assessment of outdated data, and this was 'not considered material'.
requirement: Use of outdated data that no longer reflects current conditions must be controlled and removed.
verbatim_quote_ka: დ) მოძველებული მონაცემების გამოყენების კონტროლი და აღმოფხვრა, თუ მონაცემებში არსებული ტენდენცია…
expected_fix: Test time-stability, exclude or weight distorted periods, and document the decision.

what_the_document_says: The scope is the 'standard scope applied equally to all models', not linked to model risk.
requirement: Validation intensity must correspond to the model's risk level.
verbatim_quote_ka: 42. მოდელის რისკის დონის მიხედვით მოდელის გამომყენებელმა სუბიექტმა უნდა განსაზღვროს…
expected_fix: State the model's tier and justify the scope.

what_the_document_says: The validators recommend cutting the cut-off by 40 points for one segment based on expert opinion, without re-estimation or quantitative analysis.
requirement: Expert-judgement replacement of parameters must be justified quantitatively, including back-testing, and monitored.
verbatim_quote_ka: ბ.ბ1) თუ მოდელის ვალიდაციის შედეგები არადამაკმაყოფილებელია და ახალი მონაცემებისა და…
expected_fix: Base the cut-off change on quantitative analysis and back-testing; define monitoring.

what_the_document_says: Sensitivity and stability tests under extreme values were not performed, on the assumption that tree models are robust.
requirement: The conceptual soundness assessment must include sensitivity and stability tests, including extreme values.
expected_fix: Perform sensitivity and stress tests on the inputs.

what_the_document_says: The report is approved by the head of RAMD, who also supervises the scoring (development) group. The validator sits in the same department.
requirement: Validation must be independent of development.
verbatim_quote_ka: შიდა ვალიდაცია მოდელის აგებისა და გამოყენებისგან დამოუკიდებლად უნდა განხორციელდეს.
expected_fix: Have the report approved by an independent validation head who reports outside development.

what_the_document_says: The model was launched (01.07.2021) on a temporary permission before validation was completed.
requirement: Launch is allowed only after all three lines have positively assessed the model and an independent approver has agreed.
verbatim_quote_ka: თანხმობა უნდა გასცეს დაცვის ხაზებისაგან დამოუკიდებელმა პირმა/ორგანომ
expected_fix: Do not launch before validation; if urgent, restrict use and document conditions.

requirement: The final conclusion must reflect model risk; unresolved gaps should lead to restrictions.

expected_fix: Downgrade the rating or attach use restrictions until the gaps are closed.

what_the_document_says: Data quality checks and the benchmark comparison against the logistic scorecard are performed.
requirement: Compliant. It should NOT be flagged.

what_the_document_says: Distribution goes to the CRO, Model Committee and Management Board only, not to the Supervisory Board (Risk Committee). That also breaks the bank's own policy, 6.1.
requirement: For commercial banks, regular model risk reporting must also go to the supervisory board.
verbatim_quote_ka: კომერციული ბანკის შემთხვევაში – სამეთვალყურეო საბჭოსთან
expected_fix: Add the Supervisory Board Risk Committee to the distribution.

what_the_document_says: M-001's PSI = 0.27 (red) and the digital-channel actual/predicted ratio = 1.46, yet the model 'remains in use without restriction'. There is no escalation and no restriction.
requirement: A significant change in model risk is grounds for restriction or suspension, and must be reported to the approver. The policy's 6.3 requires immediate escalation.
verbatim_quote_ka: უნდა გახდეს მოდელის გამოყენების შეზღუდვის ან შეჩერების საფუძველი
expected_fix: Escalate to the approver; consider restricting automated approvals for the digital channel; bring re-calibration forward.

what_the_document_says: The 40-point cut-off change, based on expert opinion, was implemented. Success is measured only by fewer overrides, with no back-testing of risk outcomes.
requirement: Expert-judgement replacement needs quantitative justification, including back-testing, and monitoring.
verbatim_quote_ka: ბ.ბ1) თუ მოდელის ვალიდაციის შედეგები არადამაკმაყოფილებელია და ახალი მონაცემებისა და…
expected_fix: Back-test the default rate of the affected segment; report it quantitatively.

what_the_document_says: M-003 has 12.4% missing values (above the 2% threshold). They were imputed with the mode, a +3% overlay was applied, and the model is used without restriction.
requirement: Failure to confirm that data quality standards are met must be grounds for restricting or suspending the model.
verbatim_quote_ka: 5. თუ მოდელის გამომყენებელი სუბიექტი ვერ რწმუნდება, რომ მონაცემთა ხარისხთან…
expected_fix: Formally restrict or condition use, with a documented decision by the approver, until the data is restored.

what_the_document_says: No periodic vendor test results for M-005, no contractual right to them, and no internal means of monitoring. The model stays in use anyway.
requirement: The bank must regularly receive the vendor's test results, and must have its own resources to verify performance if the vendor doesn't monitor.
verbatim_quote_ka: 42. თუ შეძენილი მოდელის მუდმივი მონიტორინგი მესამე მხარის მიერ არ ხორციელდება…
expected_fix: Amend the SLA; obtain score-level data; build internal monitoring.

what_the_document_says: There is no deviation or bias monitoring, even though the digital-channel shift involves younger applicants and the model uses age.
requirement: Ongoing monitoring must check for deviation.
expected_fix: Add deviation metrics (approval and default rates by age group and region) to the monitoring report.

what_the_document_says: The vendor model M-007 is rated 'green' solely on the vendor's own report.
requirement: Purchased models must be reviewed by the bank on a risk basis.
verbatim_quote_ka: 43. მოდელის გამომყენებელმა სუბიექტმა რისკზე დაფუძნებული მიდგომით უნდა განახორციელოს…
expected_fix: Perform an independent risk-based review of M-007.

what_the_document_says: The override analysis is performed and reported.
requirement: Compliant. It should NOT be flagged.

what_the_document_says: It cites the 2018 ethics code (№154/04).
requirement: Commercial banks must follow the code approved by NBG Order №13/04 (02.02.2021).
verbatim_quote_ka: 3. მოდელის მართვის პროცესში მოდელის გამომყენებელმა სუბიექტმა უნდა შეიმუშაოს ეთიკის პრინციპები…
expected_fix: Update the reference to 13/04.

what_the_document_says: The core principles leave out avoiding deviation and transparency. There is no definition of deviation and none of the four deviation types.
requirement: At minimum, avoiding deviation and ensuring transparency are required principles. Selection, stereotypical, behavioural and exclusion deviation must be addressed.
verbatim_quote_ka: 1. მოდელის განვითარების, დანერგვისა და გამოყენების პროცესში მოდელის გამომყენებელმა სუბიექტმა უნდა დაიცვას…
expected_fix: Add the principles, the definition and the deviation typology.

what_the_document_says: Geographic and demographic variables are allowed whenever they improve predictive power, which is effectively a proxy licence with no causal test.
requirement: Proxy variables must not be used unless they have a causal link to the outcome. All relevant customer micro-characteristics should be integrated instead.
verbatim_quote_ka: ჩამნაცვლებელი ცვლადი არ უნდა გამოიყენებოდეს…
expected_fix: Replace 4.2 with a causal-justification test and a fairness review for proxies.

what_the_document_says: Accuracy is declared the 'primary objective' and the main selection criterion.
requirement: Socially neutral outcomes should be prioritised if this does not significantly reduce accuracy.
expected_fix: Rewrite the principle to balance accuracy with neutral outcomes.

what_the_document_says: Model logic is a trade secret, and refusal reasons are never explained to customers.
requirement: The bank must increase the transparency of model-based decision logic and be able to explain it to customers when needed.
verbatim_quote_ka: 5. მოდელის გამომყენებელმა სუბიექტმა უნდა უზრუნველყოს მოდელის გამოყენებით მიღებული გადაწყვეტილების ლოგიკის გამჭირვალობის ზრდა.
expected_fix: Introduce customer-level explanations (reason codes) while protecting proprietary detail.

what_the_document_says: There are no customer education or awareness measures about AI and machine-learning decisions.
requirement: The bank must promote customer education and awareness about decisions made with machine learning and AI.
verbatim_quote_ka: 6. მოდელის გამომყენებელმა სუბიექტმა ხელი უნდა შეუწყოს მანქანური სწავლებისა და ხელოვნური ინტელექტის…
expected_fix: Add customer communication and awareness measures, for example a website notice and information in loan documents.

what_the_document_says: No procedures to identify, report and mitigate deviation in data processing and ongoing monitoring; the validators' role is limited to checking the banned-variable list. There's also no control of outdated data.
requirement: The bank must set rules and procedures to identify, report and mitigate deviation; monitor it in data processing and ongoing monitoring; remove outdated data; and control inappropriate algorithms.
verbatim_quote_ka: დ) მოძველებული მონაცემების გამოყენების კონტროლი და აღმოფხვრა, თუ მონაცემებში არსებული ტენდენცია…
expected_fix: Add a deviation-management procedure with roles across all three lines.

what_the_document_says: There is no explainability requirement for complex or black-box models.
requirement: Models must be explainable, with global and local methods for black boxes.
verbatim_quote_ka: 101. მოდელი უნდა იყოს გამჭვირვალე და უნდა იძლეოდეს ახსნისა და ინტერპრეტაციის შესაძლებლობას.
expected_fix: Add explainability requirements, or cross-reference the updated policy.

what_the_document_says: The personal data protection and human-review provisions are present.
requirement: Compliant or neutral. It should NOT be flagged as non-compliant with 151/04.

what_the_document_says: Audit scope excludes the documentation of model updates and the operational systems and data management, which are deferred to 2023.
requirement: The third line must confirm that model building, validation and updates are documented, and must assess the operational systems and data management. This is in V0 and restated in V1.
verbatim_quote_ka: 2. დაცვის მესამე ხაზი უნდა დარწმუნდეს, რომ მოდელის აგების, შიდა ვალიდაციისა და განახლების…
expected_fix: Bring update documentation and systems/data management into scope.

what_the_document_says: The timeliness of validation was not assessed.
requirement: The audit must confirm that validation is completed on time.
expected_fix: Assess validation timeliness against the plan and the inventory.

what_the_document_says: RAMD analysts who built M-001 helped with the audit's recalculations and data extraction.
requirement: The three lines of defence must be independent, so the third line can't rely on the developers to test their own model.
expected_fix: Use independent data access or external specialists; document safeguards.

what_the_document_says: The co-source audit partner previously advised on the M-003 methodology.
requirement: Outsourced audit must follow the 47/04 principles and preserve the independence of the three lines.
verbatim_quote_ka: 2014 წლის 13 ივნისის №47/04 ბრძანებით
expected_fix: Assess conflicts of interest; exclude M-003 from the partner's work or replace the partner.

what_the_document_says: The methodology refers only to the IIA standards, not the Corporate Governance Code for commercial banks (Order 215/04).
requirement: From 2022 the third line at a commercial bank must also meet the Corporate Governance Code, Order 215/04 of 26.09.2018.
verbatim_quote_ka: 3. კომერციული ბანკის შემთხვევაში, დაცვის მესამე ხაზი ასევე უნდა აკმაყოფილებდეს…
expected_fix: Add the 215/04 requirements to the audit methodology.

what_the_document_says: The audit concludes that having no tiering 'complies with the regulation' and makes no recommendation.
requirement: This was correct under V0, but from 2022 a risk-based tiering methodology is mandatory, so the conclusion becomes wrong.
verbatim_quote_ka: 41. შიდა ვალიდაციის პროცესი უნდა წარიმართოს რისკზე დაფუძნებული მიდგომის გამოყენებით.
expected_fix: Re-rate F6 as a finding with a recommendation.

what_the_document_says: The scope has no test of compliance with the ethics, deviation and explainability requirements.
requirement: The audit must confirm compliance with the regulation, which from 2022 includes Art. 9¹ and 5.10¹–10³.
verbatim_quote_ka: 101. მოდელი უნდა იყოს გამჭვირვალე და უნდა იძლეოდეს ახსნისა და ინტერპრეტაციის შესაძლებლობას.
expected_fix: Add ethics, deviation and explainability tests to the audit programme.

what_the_document_says: A model launched before validation (F3) and a supervisory model used without NBG consent (F4) are rated only 'medium', and 5.2 says the processes 'comply'.
requirement: These are direct breaches of the regulation, so the ratings and conclusion understate the risk.
verbatim_quote_ka: თანხმობა უნდა გასცეს დაცვის ხაზებისაგან დამოუკიდებელმა პირმა/ორგანომ
expected_fix: Re-rate F3 and F4 as high; correct the 5.2 conclusion.

what_the_document_says: Findings on the missing M-007 validation and the incomplete inventory.
requirement: Correct findings. They should NOT be flagged as wrong.

what_the_document_says: No internal validation results; validation is promised 'after NBG consent'.
requirement: The application must include the internal validation results. It also breaks the bank's own policy, 8.2.
expected_fix: Complete the internal validation and attach the report.

what_the_document_says: Reporting to the NBG is offered quarterly.
requirement: A monthly report on the supervisory model is required.
verbatim_quote_ka: ყოველთვიურად წარუდგინოს საქართველოს ეროვნულ ბანკს ანგარიშგება
expected_fix: Commit to monthly reporting.

what_the_document_says: The model update is planned every 2 years.
requirement: The supervisory model must be updated at least annually.
verbatim_quote_ka: განაახლოს საზედამხედველო მოდელი მინიმუმ ყოველწლიურად
expected_fix: Commit to an update at least annually.

what_the_document_says: Significant changes would be notified within 30 days after implementation.
requirement: Significant changes must be disclosed and justified with error analysis, and approved by the NBG within 30 working days. Until approval, the pre-update model stays in use.
expected_fix: Change to prior notification and approval.

what_the_document_says: The model has been used in the credit process since 01.06.2021, before the application date of 10.08.2021.
requirement: The income assessment model is a supervisory model; its use requires prior NBG consent.
verbatim_quote_ka: 2020 წლის 13 მარტის №44/04 ბრძანებით დამტკიცებული დებულებით
expected_fix: Suspend or limit its use, or explain the transitional arrangement, pending consent.

what_the_document_says: The Random Forest component is declared 'not directly interpretable', with no global or local explainability, even though decisions are automated without expert involvement.
requirement: Black-box components need explainability methods, and the need is higher when decisions are automated and affect customers.
verbatim_quote_ka: 103. გამჭირვალობის საჭიროება იზრდება, თუ მოდელის გამოყენებით მიღებული გადაწყვეტილებები…
expected_fix: Add SHAP, PDP and surrogate analysis for the Random Forest component.

what_the_document_says: Municipality and age are used, and the benchmark matrix is region-based. There is no deviation or bias analysis for income estimation.
requirement: Deviation must be avoided, and proxies are allowed only with a causal link.
verbatim_quote_ka: ჩამნაცვლებელი ცვლადი არ უნდა გამოიყენებოდეს…
expected_fix: Add a deviation analysis by region and age; justify or remove the proxies.

what_the_document_says: Training data spans 2017–2020, including the pandemic, with no outdated-data assessment.
requirement: Outdated data that no longer matches current conditions must be controlled and removed.
verbatim_quote_ka: დ) მოძველებული მონაცემების გამოყენების კონტროლი და აღმოფხვრა, თუ მონაცემებში არსებული ტენდენცია…
expected_fix: Document a time-stability analysis and data window selection.

what_the_document_says: Owner, responsible persons, creation date, purpose, segment, data sources, construction, assumptions, limitations, expert alignment and benchmark are all included.
requirement: Compliant parts of the application. They should NOT be flagged.
